Before you order 100 balls, evaluate a sample.

A practical checklist for schools, clubs, companies and resellers:

1. Match the model and size to your participants and planned activity.
2. Try handling and bounce on the actual indoor surface.
3. Review cleaning, storage and supervision needs.
4. Confirm the exact SKU, packaging and any required documents.
5. Agree the quantity, freight, delivery estimate and full written quote before a bulk order.

A soft indoor ball is not a regulation-ball replacement or a promise of silence. Test suitability for your own setting.

Which matters most for your program: ball feel, size mix or storage?

posts.title: Five no-bounce indoor activity ideas
posts.body:
An indoor ball break does not have to mean constant bouncing.

Try a short round of:
1. Seated handovers
2. Around-the-waist moves
3. Mirror moves
4. Step-and-freeze
5. Gentle target rolls, where suitable

Clear the space, agree on play hours and pause if sound carries. A soft ball or mat cannot remove building vibration. Adapt each activity to the people and space.

Save these ideas for your next indoor break. Follow MING EAGLE for practical indoor-play and equipment guides.
